_doc: Parameter->coefficient transform curves for RolandCloud JUNO-60 VST3. See docs/PARAM_APPLY_MAP.md. Image base for 'rva' fields = 0x180000000 (IDA convention; runtime base 0x7FF91DC60000 is equivalent). All rvas below are IDA-style (0x180000000+rva).

apply_model.summary: value -> integer engine step (0..N) -> per-parameter float LUT lookup -> raw store into descriptor slot. Host-normalized 0..1 is NOT transformed at the VST3 boundary; denormalization is deferred into the engine apply path.

denormalize_lut_fn.signature: double sub_356380(engine, int tableId, int step)
denormalize_lut_fn.note: 66 cases (tableId 0..65). Some tableIds are samplerate-selected (see samplerate_dispatch).

range_param_toPlain_fn.note: Steinberg-SDK RangeParameter path (host-facing params). min/max live in the Parameter object (offsets +824/+832), NOT in the 40-byte engine descriptor.

per_param_scale_offset_apply.formula: value*scale[idx] + offset  (scale/offset constants near dword_7FF91E7450B4, rva ~0x7450B4 region)
per_param_scale_offset_apply.note: visible only in asm (Hex-Rays drops the implicit xmm float arg to 0x3C1090)

setParamNormalized.behavior: clamp(value,0,1) stored NORMALIZED at param-object +808; notifies; does NOT reach engine slots

process.behavior: getPoint() double normalized value passed verbatim into a mutex-guarded event queue at engine+440; drained later where denormalize occurs

samplerate_dispatch.note: Time-domain params (ENV/LFO rates) pick the tableId by current samplerate, so the resulting slot coefficient is samplerate-specific. The captured oracle is 96 kHz.

denormalize_lut_tables._note: Contiguous float[] LUTs, 4 bytes/entry, indexed by clamped step. CONTENTS ARE NOT IN THE PROVIDED DATA DUMPS (region rva 0x5C97D0..0x5CE6E0 is below the dumped .rdata start 0x934000). Extract this 20240-byte blob from the binary to complete the port.

sysex_transfer_curves_decoded._note: These closed-form curves are EMBEDDED in the patch SysEx transcoder sub_351710 (rva 0x351710). They map a 0..255 byte index to a value, used to align the JUNO-60 hardware SysEx byte domain with the internal display/value domain. They are DECODED FROM CODE (no external data) and are useful as reference / sanity bounds, but they are NOT the same as the engine denormalize LUTs above (which produce the per-sample slot coefficients). Provided because they are the only fully-recoverable curves.

missing_data_blobs.needed_for: host param registration + display only (NOT audio)
